style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: How to Pray
images.concept: Father — a single word that changes everything, the posture of the whole prayer in the first address
images.imageAlt: Morning light falling through an open window onto a bare stone floor where someone has knelt, the impression still faintly visible in the dust
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, warm morning light pouring through an open window onto a bare stone floor, in the pool of light a faint impression or slight disturbance in the thin dust layer on the floor where someone recently knelt, the impression barely perceptible — just a suggestion of presence and prayer, the window itself out of frame with only its light visible, heavy warm analog film grain in the darker stone areas, muted warm palette of pale stone and amber morning light, the trace of prayer in the light, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Stronger than the Strong Man
images.concept: The finger of God — a greater power overpowers and plunders the strong man's house
images.imageAlt: A heavy iron lock burst open on an ancient wooden door, the lock broken from within, morning light on the splintered wood
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close-up of an ancient heavy iron lock mechanism broken and forced open on a thick weathered wooden door, the lock mechanism sprung from within rather than cut from outside, the surrounding wood showing the force of opening, warm morning light falling across the broken lock and door surface, heavy film grain, muted warm palette of dark iron and faded wood, the broken lock — not picked from outside but overwhelmed by superior force within, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Sign of Jonah
images.concept: The body itself as the only sign — three days in the deep, then the witness of survival
images.imageAlt: Dark water surface from underwater looking up, light rippling and refracting from far above, deep blue-black depth below
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, underwater perspective looking straight up toward the surface, the water surface visible far above as a luminous rippling plane of refracted light, everything below the photographer in absolute dark blue-black, the light from the surface distorted and dancing, heavy film grain in the dark water, muted near-monochrome palette of deep blue-black and overexposed surface light, the deep and the distant light — survival witnessed from within the depth, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Woes against the Religious Elite
images.concept: Whitewashed tombs and hidden burdens — the weight of religion without mercy, knowledge without entry
images.imageAlt: A whitewashed stone wall with the white surface cracking and peeling to reveal dark rough stone beneath, harsh noon light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close-up of a whitewashed stone wall with the white lime surface cracking and peeling in large flakes, the dark rough stone substrate visible beneath the failing white layer, harsh flat noon light revealing every crack and inconsistency with no mercy, the white surface pretending uniformity while the dark reality beneath shows through, heavy film grain in the texture, muted palette of chalk white and dark gray stone, the cracking whitewash — the surface that cannot sustain the performance of purity, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9
